csv_project_name: CMAR for Flour Bluff ISD Multiple District Projects
csv_scope_of_work: It is the intent of the District to select a CMAR through a one-step process for the Auditorium Renovation. Anticipated to be a comprehensive renovation of the existing auditorium facility to support theatre, technical theatre, and dance programs. Work will include modernization of performance and support spaces, upgrades to theatrical systems, and improvements to functionality and flexibility for student use. The scope will also include building-wide lighting and MEP (mechanical, electrical, and plumbing) system updates, roof repairs, and general building modernization to extend the life of the facility and improve efficiency and safety
